text: Gomɗii Haaruuna maakaniino ɓe ado ruttagol Muusaa e maɓɓe: "Tafugol ñalahol kol e aatugol makkol wonaali si wanaa ndarndorɗom on fii yo gomɗinɗo on feeñu o senndondira e keefeeru on, pellet, Joomi mo'on -onon yimɓe- ko On Jeyɗo Yurmeende nden, wanaa on mo maranaa on lorra wanaa nafa, wonaa fii non o yurmee on, jokkee lam e Rewugol Mo Kanko Tun, ɗoftoɗon yamiroore am nden kadi e ɗalugol rewugol tanaa Makko".
